subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a body of the urban local body administration?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zila Panchayat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Zila Panchayat** is a rural local government body at the district level in India.
 
• It does not fall under the urban local body administration category.
 
• Zila Panchayat is responsible for the administration of rural areas and villages.
 
• It operates under the Panchayati Raj system and focuses on the development of the district as a whole.
 
• Urban local bodies like Nagar Panchayat, Municipality, and Municipal Corporation handle the administration of urban and semi-urban areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nagar Panchayat:**

 
 
• Nagar Panchayat is an urban local body for areas in transition from rural to urban.
 
• It is responsible for providing basic services and infrastructure to small towns.
 
 
 
• **Municipality:**
 
 
• Municipality, also known as Municipal Council, is an urban local body for smaller urban areas.
 
• It is responsible for the administration of the town and providing civic amenities.
 
 
 
• **Municipal Corporation:**
 
 
• Municipal Corporation is the highest form of urban local body administration, found in large cities.
 
• It is responsible for managing city infrastructure, public services, and local governance.
 
 
 
• **Panchayati Raj:**
 
 
• Panchayati Raj is a system of local self-government for rural areas in India.
 
• It consists of three levels: Gram Panchayat (village level), Panchayat Samiti (block level), and Zila Panchayat (district level).
